title: data for diagram.pin
description: Rev 2 (M1): owner only, from an owner UI credential (contract 3.5: ownerUi). Make the current revision the owner's source of truth (pinned true) or hand the diagram back to the agents as a draft (pinned false). An unpin is itself the owner act that names this diagram: the request targets one task and its attached diagram_id, so no owner note, ask or other record can stand in for it, and no coordinator write ever changes the pin (403 forbidden_for_role for a coordinator; 403 owner_ui_only for an owner bearer that is not a UI credential). Changes the pointer only, no revision; written as a side-log line so the history shows it. Not the board's row pin (pin.set): the two are independent. Idempotent: pinning a pinned diagram keeps the first {by, at, rev}. Rev 3 (contract 3.7): owner-only, needs an owner device (TOTP step-up once per device); otherwise 403 owner_device_required.
